description: This file defines the StaticContextService class which provides methods for analyzing and generating code snippets related to static context in an autocomplete system. It includes methods for extracting relevant types and headers, formatting snippets, and managing AST parsing with Tree-sitter.

classes.name: StaticContextService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to analyze code context, extract relevant types and headers, and generate static code snippets for autocomplete features.

methods.name: logAutocompleteStaticSnippet
methods.description: Logs details of the static snippet context including hole type, relevant types, and headers.

methods.name: formatAutocompleteStaticSnippet
methods.description: Formats the static snippet context into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Main method to retrieve autocomplete static snippets based on the current code context, including extracting relevant types and headers.

methods.name: getHoleContext
methods.description: Uses Tree-sitter to parse the code and identify the hole's context, including function signature and range.

methods.name: extractRelevantTypes
methods.description: Recursively extracts relevant type definitions from source files.

methods.name: extractRelevantTypesHelper
methods.description: Helper for extracting relevant types, following type references and definitions.

methods.name: extractRelevantHeaders
methods.description: Extracts relevant headers based on source files and relevant types.

methods.name: extractRelevantHeadersHelper
methods.description: Helper for extracting headers, matching types and declarations.

methods.name: generateTargetTypes
methods.description: Generates a set of target type nodes for matching.

methods.name: generateTargetTypesHelper
methods.description: Recursively collects type nodes related to the target type.

methods.name: isTypeEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two syntax nodes represent equivalent types.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a syntax node to a string representation for comparison.

methods.name: insertAtPosition
methods.description: Inserts text into file contents at a specified cursor position.

methods.name: getTypeScriptFilesFromWorkspaces
methods.description: Scans workspace directories for TypeScript files.

methods.name: scanDirectoryForTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for files with .ts extension, skipping common directories.
